name: Post Harvest Engineering of Cereals, Pulses and Oil Seeds

units.title: Cleaning, Grading, and Separation Equipment in Post-Harvest Processing
topics: Operations related to cleaning and grading such as aspiration
sieve analysis and evaluation of screen efficiency
Study of different separation equipment including gravity separator
velvet roll separator, and colour sorting machines

units.title: Size Reduction Principles and Material Handling Systems in Food Processing
topics: Fundamentals of size reduction along with laws (Kick’s
Overview of machines such as jaw crusher
trucks (both refrigerated and non-refrigerated), and pneumatic conveying systems

units.title: Mixing Operations and Rice Processing Technologies
topics: Mixing operations: theory of mixing of solids and pastes
mixing efficiency, and types of mixers used for different materials
modern rice mills, and associated unit operations

units.title: Milling Technologies of Wheat, Pulses and Maize
topics: Wheat milling: process steps and machinery involved
Pulse milling traditional and modern techniques
CFTRI and Pant-nagar methods, and milling equipment
Processing of maize and its products through dry and wet milling methods

units.title: Maize Processing and Oilseed Extraction Technologies
topics: Processing of maize and its products through dry and wet milling methods
Oilseed processing: extraction methods including mechanical pressing and solvent extraction

units.title: Extrusion Cooking Technology and By-Product Utilization
topics: 8 Program Name: Bachelor of Engineering Level: Under Graduate Branch: Food Engineering & Technology Subject Code: BE05051031 Subject Name: Post Harvest Engineering of Cereals
Pulses and Oil Seeds Extrusion cooking: basic principles
types of extruders (single and twin screw), and utilization of by-products
